title: Resolution urging Albany to sign bill easing balcony solar rules
summary: This resolution calls on the Governor to sign S.8512-C/A.9111-C, known as the SUNNY Act, which would exempt small plug-in balcony solar panels from standard utility interconnection and net metering requirements. The bill would cap these portable solar devices at 1,200 watts and require safety certification, making it easier for renters and homeowners to install them without utility approval. The Council says this could help lower energy costs for New Yorkers, about 70 percent of whom rent their homes.
